text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun unleashes her genius talent 
to conquer the Tenno Sho (Spring).

Everyone gave it their all, running the 
best race they possibly could. Even so, 
winners and losers must be decided.

What became certain today is that the goal 
of "sharing the Marvelous with the world" 
is being firmly fulfilled.

Her next challenge is the finale of the 
Spring Senior Spring Triple Crown: the 
Takarazuka Kinen. Operation Marvelous 
World is finally entering its climax.
